answer: Each epoch the network draws 5 random auditors per account cluster, each staking 20 POA. They replay a sample of its work, and any cluster with 3 matching hardware fingerprints loses its payout. Each extra fake identity adds another audited slot and 20 POA at risk, so cost grows linearly while a shared ridge in timing data exposes the operator. A relic of past misbehavior stays in a public vault ledger that anyone can verify.
